newsitem.title: FINLAND: MERITA FORMS NEW VENTURE FUND.
newsitem.headline: MERITA FORMS NEW VENTURE FUND.

text.p: Finnish Merita Bank said on Wednesday that it, Merita Capital Oy and three institutional investors have set up a new venture capital fund, called Profita Fund I Ky, to target small- and medium-sized firms.
"(The fund's) total capital is 73 million markka," Merita said in a statement.
The bank said the other investors in the fund were state-backed investment fund Suomen Teollisuussijoitus, the Elake-Varma pension insurance company and Sampo's corporate insurance unit Yritys-Sampo.
The fund's capital would subsequently be raised to 100-120 million markka by offering a stake of the venture capital operations to three or four investors, Merita said.

Merita Capital Oy's managing director Jouko Helomaa was quoted as saying the fund's capital would be invested for two to three years at a time in corporate acquisitions and companies believed to have potential.
The fund will offer an array of financial instruments and will be administered by Merita's subsidiary Merita Capital Oy, the bank said.
